photo.facebook:
Spot says $32. The coin in your cart says $38.40. That $6.40 gap is the premium, and it pays for minting, dealer overhead, shipping, and profit. Bars carry the lowest premiums at about 5%, Eagles run about 20%, and tiny fractional coins can hit 130%. The 10 second check: total paid divided by ounces, compared to spot. Run it on every quote.
